definitions.explanation: The practice of giving an old item (typically a car, appliance, or electronic device) to a seller to reduce the price of a new purchase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下取|したど}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To trade in an old car.

examples.japanese: {下取|したど}り⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The trade-in price was higher than I expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}える→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧とき、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下取|したど}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧みた。
examples.english: When replacing my smartphone, I asked if they could take my current model as a trade-in.

notes:
USAGE:
{下取|したど}り is most commonly used when buying cars, electronics, and appliances. The seller evaluates the old item and deducts its value from the new purchase price.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下取|したど}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to trade in, to offer as a trade-in)
- {下取|したど}り⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (trade-in price/value)
- {下取|したど}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to have something accepted as a trade-in)
- {下取|したど}り⟦{査定|さてい}→査定：07518_satei⟧ (trade-in appraisal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{買|か}い{取|と}り→買い取る：16704_kaitoru⟧ means buyback or purchase, where the store buys your item outright. {下取|したど}り specifically implies exchanging an old item when purchasing a new one.
